task.speaker: client
task.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.

predictions.requirement_summary: Create a national SHATTER HOUSE master website that presents the brand, lets visitors select a location, and connects to independently operated location websites.

historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text:
Thanks for the feedback!
https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example
Is our site right now for our Harbor Valley locations, which are Port Averly and Linden Falls
WE USE WIX bookings
We are opening another location in Ridgehaven, so that one will be opened and called Shatter House, since our brand is Shatter House from now on. So we want to have our master site https://shatterhouse.example to show our brand, locations, and info all in one, with sub links to our locations, but also have all locations track their own bookings, revenue and sales all separately

historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text: As we begin franchising, we want to integrate additional locations while still giving each of them full control. I want https://shatterhouse.example built from scratch, but using the same kind of template. One of our competitors has the layout we really like: it is simple, lists every location, and is easy to navigate.

historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text: Yes, that's the one.

historical_evidence.speaker: freelancer
historical_evidence.text: Before I begin, I want to verify the plan. I’ll reuse the content, images, and booking information from https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example, while the competitor’s site will serve as the design reference for the overall layout, structure, and navigation. The result will be a new website with your own branding. Thanks for confirming—is that correct?

historical_evidence.speaker: freelancer
historical_evidence.text: Before I proceed, can you confirm that you already own https://shatterhouse.example, that I should build the new website on that domain, and that https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example should remain live throughout the transition?

historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text: Yes, that's a problem—every location needs separate payouts. Would we have to create two wix websites, one for the Shatter House MASTER and one for Ridgehaven directly, so it runs separately, and then also connect to Harbor Valley Shatter House on its own wix account so each is controlled and tracked separately?

historical_evidence.speaker: freelancer
historical_evidence.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Selecting a location like Ridgehaven or Harbor Valley will take the visitor to that location’s own Wix website, where bookings and payment processing will occur. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text: Bookings would be handled by the related location websites, so the main site itself would not need any booking system.

historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

Before we finalize the pricing, I need to clarify the revised scope, though I really do want to work with you. The $800 we discussed covered the https://shatterhouse.example master website. historical_evidence.speaker: client
historical_evidence.text: It's really one type of website that stays the same throughout all the websites—we copy and paste it and just change the branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same.

historical_evidence.speaker: freelancer
historical_evidence.text:
The revised plan is materially larger than the original scope of one website for $800 because it now includes a second, separate Wix website. Although the design can follow the same structure, the implementation is not simply a matter of copying and pasting. Every site still requires its own Wix setup, booking configuration, payment setup, testing, and location-specific adjustments.

I believe that is a fair compromise, and I would genuinely like the opportunity to work with you.

historical_evidence.speaker: freelancer
historical_evidence.text: We can proceed at $800, and I completely understand the budget constraint. Before we finalize everything, though, could you explain how you envision the second website working? The structure of the master website is clear to me, but I want to understand exactly how the second site should be organized so we agree before moving forward.
